heart.name: heart
heart.description: a heart with a pulse line, for heart rate (Material Design md-heart_pulse)

steps.name: steps
steps.description: a shoe print, for step count (Material Design md-shoe_print)

flame.name: flame
flame.description: a flame, for calories (Material Design md-fire)

alarm.name: alarm
alarm.description: an alarm clock with bells, for an alarm indicator (Material Design md-alarm)

dnd.name: dnd
dnd.description: a solid bell with a slash, for do-not-disturb (Material Design md-bell_off -- a solid glyph reads more reliably than an outline one at the small sizes a status row uses)

notification.name: notification
notification.description: a speech bubble; draw a count on top of it (Material Design md-comment)

floors.name: floors
floors.description: a flight of stairs, for floors climbed (Material Design md-stairs)

distance.name: distance
distance.description: a map pin with a distance mark (Material Design md-map_marker_distance)

phone.name: phone
phone.description: a phone, for phone-connected status (Material Design md-cellphone)

body_battery.name: body_battery
body_battery.description: a figure with raised arms, for Body Battery -- deliberately not the plain 'battery' glyph, which means device charge (Material Design md-human_handsup)

stress.name: stress
stress.description: a head with a lightning flash, for the stress score (Material Design md-head_flash)

sunrise.name: sunrise
sunrise.description: the sun rising over a horizon line (Material Design md-weather_sunset_up)

sunset.name: sunset
sunset.description: the sun setting below a horizon line (Material Design md-weather_sunset_down)

altitude.name: altitude
altitude.description: layered mountains, for altitude/elevation (Material Design md-image_filter_hdr)

pressure.name: pressure
pressure.description: a gauge dial, for sea-level pressure (Material Design md-gauge)

temperature.name: temperature
temperature.description: a thermometer, for a single current-temperature reading (Material Design md-thermometer)

temperature_range.name: temperature_range
temperature_range.description: a thermometer with tick lines, for a high/low temperature range (Material Design md-thermometer_lines)

calendar_event.name: calendar_event
calendar_event.description: a calendar page with a clock, for a scheduled event (Material Design md-calendar_clock)

calendar.name: calendar
calendar.description: a calendar page, for a plain date (Material Design md-calendar_month)

calendar_day.name: calendar_day
calendar_day.description: a calendar page marked 'today', for a weekday+day-of-month reading (Material Design md-calendar_today)

intensity.name: intensity
intensity.description: a running figure, for intensity minutes (Material Design md-run_fast)

run.name: run
run.description: a running figure, for running VO2 max (Material Design md-run)

bike.name: bike
bike.description: a bicycle, for cycling VO2 max (Material Design md-bike)

lungs.name: lungs
lungs.description: a pair of lungs, for respiration rate (Material Design md-lungs)

pulse_ox.name: pulse_ox
pulse_ox.description: a water-drop percentage glyph, for blood oxygen saturation -- deliberately not the 'heart' glyph, which means heart rate (Material Design md-water_percent)

recovery.name: recovery
recovery.description: a sand timer, for recovery time (Material Design md-timer_sand)

training.name: training
training.description: a line chart, for training status (Material Design md-chart_line)

finish_flag.name: finish_flag
finish_flag.description: a checkered flag, for a race time predictor (Material Design md-flag_checkered)

pace.name: pace
pace.description: a speedometer, for a race pace predictor (Material Design md-speedometer)

sleep.name: sleep
sleep.description: a bed, for the sleep score (Material Design md-bed)

solar.name: solar
solar.description: a bright sun, for solar input (Material Design md-white_balance_sunny)

wheelchair.name: wheelchair
wheelchair.description: a wheelchair figure, for wheelchair pushes (Material Design md-wheelchair_accessibility)

golf.name: golf
golf.description: a golf flag, for the last golf round score (Material Design md-golf)

weather.name: weather
weather.description: a generic partly-cloudy glyph, for a data element's fixed, type-keyed weather icon -- deliberately not the value-keyed condition icon 'icon: {for: weather.condition}' resolves on-device (Material Design md-weather_partly_cloudy)

weather_partly_snowy_rainy.name: weather_partly_snowy_rainy
weather_partly_snowy_rainy.description: weather: partly snowy rainy (Material Design md-weather_partly_snowy_rainy)
